result: Implemented and directed tested on CPU, CUDA, Apple and Vulkan; no full-artifact/model or performance acceptance.

contract.inputs: A[T,A,K], A=1 or S; IDs dense I32[T,S], output[T,S,N]. Existing dtype/codec/group and mixed-affine promotion remain.
contract.views: Actual zero-slot-stride view with contiguous K and element-aligned nonoverlapping token rows; test token pitch80 for K64.
contract.math: Original codec, scale/bias dtype, F32 affine product/add and dot/group accumulation, MX scale cast, final output boundaries unchanged. No implicit precision change.
contract.storage: No full T*S*K activation expansion required. CPU collapses before casts and uses selected per-slot group dots; CUDA addresses original A; Apple uses native indexed broadcast; Vulkan stages physical A span and retains per-group workspaces.
contract.architecture: Existing schema/carriers/Queue/Invocation; no model whitelist, executor, hidden ID readback or public descriptor ABI field. Private CUDA host/native geometry updated together; private Vulkan ProgramSpecV3 prevents silent old by-value callers.

CUDA.neighbors: 18 precision,5 original packed,4 CT Graph; common probes are not GPU tests

retained_failures: Original frozen inference source rejects dense A1 and true shared View; both controls and exact same probe object retained.
Initial 3 test compiles fail because two SCOPED_TRACE macros shared one source line; root split lines,3 test owners rebuilt and passed.
Initial in-tree lock update used expanded raw tree hashes; canonical CMake audit rejected the category. Correct normalized vendored hash and NOTICE identities then verified.
Offline IREE compiler schedule-count32 assertion was brittle after grouped ABI change; export set/signatures remain21 and actual generated count recorded.
MSVC C4838 in private IREE physical extent list fixed with existing bounded iree_hal_dim_t conversion; failed source,command and log retained.
limits: New shared execution witnesses cover F32/BF16 affine5, denseA1 and real zero-slot/token-gap80, duplicate IDs, two value updates and checked invalid IDs. Other shared format/precision domains are not exhaustively runtime tested.
Apple arbitrary nested lazy Views, general decode/QMV contraction and typed embedding two-RNE equivalence are not established by this batch.
Vulkan retains per-K-group activation/weight workspaces and native staging; no zero-allocation,zero-copy or peak-memory claim.

Windows hardware was separately queried as RTX4070 SM8.9 driver617.14; fixtures use default contexts and do not emit selected physical-device UUID. The Vulkan default-context run does not independently pin a device identity.
No full selected artifact payload/model, quality, throughput, peak-memory or Linux acceptance.
Later common binding/layout architecture edits are a separate batch; this package preserves the actual earlier common snapshot and does not rebuild against later source.
reproduction: Current canonical checkout plus recorded toolchains/caches and source snapshots. Exact commands/dependencies/logs are retained; SDK binaries, executables,objects,maps and caches are intentionally excluded. Final MLX encoded module and canonical regeneration scripts are included.
